Emily is Running for Re-Election on November 3
Join The Fighting 50th Team for updates!

Overcame massive oil and gas industry opposition to enact a first-in-the-nation law tackling the state’s largest source of emissions with the All-Electric Buildings Act, while holding accountable polluters who abuse North Brooklyn’s environment.

Worked for years to redesign the dangerous roads of McGuinness, adding bike and pedestrian accessibility and limiting crashes, finally securing the funding to complete the redesign after years of stalling from corporate interests.
Helped thousands of constituents access resources and services, hosted tenant clinics and community town halls, and secured investments for safer streets, open space and mass transit.
Protecting Our Climate & Lowering Your Bills

In 2023, we heard the voices of hundreds of Greenpointers and made it clear that our community’s representation shouldn’t be diluted or divided, blocking a redistricting attempt and keeping our district mostly the same.
Do you live in District 50? If so, reach out and let’s hear your concerns, none too big or small.
Our campaign isn’t powered by high finance or well-connected lobbyists, but Greenpoint and Williamsburg neighbors like you.
We’ve continued to show the political world the impossible was possible, but there’s still more work to do.
We’d love to have you involved in our campaign, to help forge our community’s future together
Big corporations and the 1% don’t like us, and they’ve spent millions of dollars trying to defeat us.
Thankfully, we have the support of you and our neighbors. From printing petitions to buying pizza for volunteers, your financial support makes our campaign vision a reality.
Plus, with the NY State matching funds program, your donation could be matched up to 12x by the state!
It’s the honor of a lifetime to represent our North Brooklyn neighborhoods in Albany. I take my deep knowledge and love of this community into the halls of power to fight for you.”
Thank you for visiting my campaign website.
